faq.title: Clearing Operational Friction for Enterprise AEC Firms.
faq.q1: How do you guarantee the security of our proprietary facility metadata and Revit models?
faq.a1: We deploy Sovereign AI infrastructures. We do not route sensitive data through public AI APIs. By utilizing our Edge AI Appliance (hardware) or Enterprise Private Cloud (Docker containers), your proprietary geometry and metadata remain locked behind your own corporate firewall. We guarantee 100% data isolation for classified government and healthcare infrastructure.
faq.q2: Does your algorithmic automation comply with European public tender mandates?
faq.a2: Yes. Our custom Python and C# pipelines are strictly engineered for absolute output compliance. We automate metadata validation to perfectly align with ISO 19650 (DACH/Global) and UNI 11337 / Decreto BIM (Italy). This eliminates human error and secures your eligibility for high-stakes public bids.
faq.q3: Will our architectural team need to learn Python or C# to operate your tools?
faq.a3: No. We operate as your external R&D tech lab based in Padua, Italy. We write the complex algorithms and package them into intuitive, custom pyRevit interfaces. Your engineering team simply clicks a button to execute the code, reducing bottleneck resolution time from days to seconds with zero learning curve.
